jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.location: Sharjah, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
📢 WE’RE HIRING: FINANCIAL ANALYST!
📊💼
Are you detail-oriented with a passion for numbers, financial planning, and business analysis? Join our team and help drive smarter business decisions through accurate financial insights!
📌 Position:
Financial Analyst
📍 Location:
Dubai, UAE
💰 Estimated Salary:
AED 8,000–15,000 per month
🕒 Employment Type:
Full-Time
💼 Key Responsibilities

Analyze financial data and prepare financial reports.
Monitor company budgets, expenses, and cash flow.
Develop financial forecasts and business projections.
Evaluate financial performance and identify trends.
Assist with budgeting and financial planning.
Conduct financial research and risk assessments.
Recommend strategies to improve financial performance.
Present financial findings to management.

✅ Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
Experience in financial analysis or a similar role.
Strong analytical and numerical skills.
Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
Understanding of financial reporting and budgeting.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
ACCA, CFA, or other relevant qualifications are an advantage.

🎁 What We Offer

✨ Competitive salary and performance bonuses

✨ Career advancement opportunities

✨ Professional training and development

✨ Supportive working environment

✨ Annual leave and company benefits
